ex.en: She volunteered to help organize the charity concert.
ex.zh: 她自愿帮忙筹办慈善音乐会。

words.note: volunteer 后接 to do 或 for sth，一般不用动名词。

ex.en: Our two projects overlap in several areas, so we share resources.
ex.zh: 我们两个项目在几方面重叠，因此共享资源。

words.note: overlap 可作动词和名词，常与 with 连用。

ex.en: Critics say advertising encourages a shallow materialism among young people.
ex.zh: 批评者认为广告助长了年轻人的浅薄物质主义。

words.note: materialism 兼指哲学唯物主义和追求物质的价值观。

ex.en: They paid for the car in monthly installments over two years.
ex.zh: 他们用两年时间按月分期付清了车款。

words.note: 英式拼作 instalment；in installments 为常用搭配。

ex.en: The whole nation mourned the death of the scientist.
ex.zh: 全国上下都为这位科学家的去世而哀悼。

words.note: mourn 可作及物动词；mourn for sb 更强调哀悼对象。

ex.en: After the operation, he walked with a cane for several months.
ex.zh: 手术后他拄了几个月手杖。

words.note: cane 指手杖或植物的茎；sugar cane 为甘蔗。

ex.en: Don't trifle with other people's feelings just for fun.
ex.zh: 不要为了好玩而玩弄别人的感情。

words.note: a trifle 等于 a little；trifle with 表不当回事。

ex.en: Thousands of birds migrate south before the cold season begins.
ex.zh: 数以千计的鸟在寒冷季节来临前南迁。

words.note: migrate 指人或动物迁移；emigrate 移出，immigrate 移入。

ex.en: Many families gather for a special meal on Easter Sunday.
ex.zh: 许多家庭在复活节星期日团聚享用特别的一餐。

words.note: Easter 前用介词 at，如 at Easter；注意首字母大写。

ex.en: Students must submit their essays by Friday afternoon.
ex.zh: 学生必须在周五下午之前提交论文。

words.note: submit sth to sb 表提交；submit to 表屈服听从。

ex.en: The novelty of city life soon wore off for the newcomer.
ex.zh: 对这位新来者而言，城市生活的新鲜感很快就消失了。

words.note: novelty 指新奇感或新奇物品；novel 作形容词表新颖的。

ex.en: The museum occupies a whole block in the city center.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆占了市中心整整一个街区。

words.note: occupy 表占空间或时间；be occupied 表忙碌。

ex.en: The team has won a string of victories this season.
ex.zh: 这支球队本赛季取得了一连串胜利。

words.note: a string of 后接可数名词复数，表一连串事物。

ex.en: The town's economy boomed after the new railway opened.
ex.zh: 新铁路开通后，小镇经济繁荣起来。

words.note: boom 可指经济繁荣或隆隆声；也说 a boom in prices。

ex.en: In the absence of clear evidence, the police dropped the case.
ex.zh: 由于缺乏明确证据，警方撤销了此案。

words.note: in the absence of 表缺少…；同源词 absent 是形容词。

ex.en: The country abolished the death penalty more than twenty years ago.
ex.zh: 这个国家二十多年前就废除了死刑。

words.note: abolish 只用于制度、法律等抽象事物，不用于具体物品。

ex.en: The new policy is expected to attract foreign investment.
ex.zh: 新政策有望吸引外国投资。

words.note: attract 直接接宾语，不说 attract to sb attention。

ex.en: Investors remain cautious about putting money into new markets.
ex.zh: 投资者对向新市场投钱仍持谨慎态度。

words.note: be cautious about doing 是常用搭配；名词是 caution。

ex.en: A thief snatched her bag and ran off down the street.
ex.zh: 小偷抢走她的手提包，沿街跑掉了。

words.note: snatch 指突然抢夺；snatch at 表急切抓住机会。

phr.en: in the blink of an eye

ex.en: She blinked back tears and forced a smile for the camera.
ex.zh: 她强忍泪水，对着镜头挤出一个微笑。

words.note: in the blink of an eye 表瞬间；blink 指眨眼。

ex.en: They reached the summit just before the sun went down.
ex.zh: 他们赶在日落前登上了峰顶。

words.note: summit 指山顶，也指最高级会议，需按语境理解。

ex.en: The air was filled with the perfume of the garden flowers.
ex.zh: 空气里弥漫着花园花卉的芬芳。

words.note: perfume 可指香水也可指香气；动词表使散发香气。

ex.en: The lenses magnify the tiny insects so students can see them clearly.
ex.zh: 透镜把微小的昆虫放大，学生能看得更清楚。

words.note: magnify 表放大或夸大；magnifying glass 是放大镜。

ex.en: The editor removed several redundant words from the sentence.
ex.zh: 编辑删去了句子中几个多余的词。

words.note: 英式 be made redundant 表被裁员，美式多用 laid off。

ex.en: The hotel is situated in a quiet street near the station.
ex.zh: 酒店位于车站附近一条安静的街上。

words.note: situated 常与 in、on、near 连用，也可指处于某种境地。

ex.en: Many small businesses closed during the long recession.
ex.zh: 长期衰退中，许多小企业倒闭了。

words.note: recession 指经济衰退，别与 recess（休息）混淆。

ex.en: He will doubtless be disappointed, but the decision is final.
ex.zh: 他无疑会失望，但决定已不可更改。

words.note: doubtless 作副词等于 undoubtedly，多放动词前或句首。

ex.en: Lack of sleep has a negative effect on memory and mood.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足对记忆和情绪有负面影响。

words.note: negative 与 positive 相对；也可指检测结果呈阴性。

ex.en: The government imposed new taxes on luxury imports.
ex.zh: 政府对进口奢侈品征收新税。

words.note: impose sth on sb 是固定搭配；名词是 imposition。

ex.en: The company issued a brief statement denying the rumors.
ex.zh: 公司发表简短声明，否认了谣言。

words.note: statement 指正式的陈述或书面单据，如 bank statement。
